name: Open-i Indiana chest collection
what: 7,470 chest radiographs of 3,955 studies with reports, frontal and lateral pairs (the Indiana University collection on Open-i)
level_truth: none; the thoracic spine in a lateral chest film
licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as two mirrors state (Hugging Face ykumards/open-i and Kaggle raddar/chest-xrays-indiana-university, read 2026-10-22); the Open-i FAQ itself was under maintenance, to confirm on the page
how_to_get: Read the download route on https://openi.nlm.nih.gov/faq.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE for each archive address the page gives.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; open, no agreement; small but frictionless lateral chest films for a thoracic-lateral probe before the gated sets arrive
